description: The more information you have about yourself the better choices and decisions you can make. #selflove #selfimprovement #choices
transcript: I collect data and I assess information, particularly when it comes to myself, the words that I don't speak, the actions that I take, the moments in which I react. I'm very mindful of that information because I'm very particular about the people, places, and the things around me. When I take my life serious, I allow the external world to be a mirror image. I take my roles and my responsibilities in life serious. My life is important to me, the way in which I move through things is important to me, and my external world needs to be a reflection of that. I start things are never how I finish them.
